[[File:Glider.jpg|thumb|300px|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] travels to [[The Forbidden City]] by glider.]]

'''Gliders''' were used on the planet [[Lahsbane/Legends|Lahsbane]] to cross the broad canyons that existed there. The native [[Lahsbee/Huhk]] aversion to technology meant this was one of the most sophisticated forms of air transport on the planet.

Gliders were also employed by the [[Anointed People]] on [[Abonshee|Masterhome]].<ref name="Godking">{{WEGCite|story=Tests of the Godking|book=Star Wars Campaign Pack}}</ref>

[[Hot air balloon]]s were also used to cross the canyons.
